_doc: Models for the trajectory check and viewer (notes/trajectory-check-2026-10-09.md). Part 1 rows point at existing prompt-locked paper-eval decodes (scripts/papereval/decode_batched.py, 3000 C4 prompts, seeds 123/124/125, T 0.9, top-k 50, 220 new actions); decode_unlocked is the same model decoded without the prompt lock (used only to count prompt edits); ckpt/ckpt_sha256 are the checkpoint those decodes were made from (checked against each decode's _meta). Part 2 rows are decoded by scripts/trajviz/edit_decode.py (type-greedy, the evaluate_edits settings). To add the 1B Reviser-Edit runs: append part2 rows with their checkpoint path, layout and saved-eval dir, then rerun edit_decode.py, edit_stats.py and build_viewer.py.
